Rae (PM): quick recap request from today's all-hands: what's the one-sentence mission focus for the next 6 months so teams can align?

Nora (CEO): Make developer-facing LLM inference predictable, inexpensive, and portable across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private. Focus: reduce cost-per-successful-request while keeping 99p latency SLO.

Cal (GTM): For go-to-market messaging, should we lead with cost or reliability?

Nora (CEO): Lead with reliability + predictable economics. Cost is important but frame it as controllable via our knobs (batching, quant).

Ethan (Head of Product): Product takeaway: publish a short perf/price snapshot per model class and a simple Hosted->Dedicated migration checklist.

Ivy (Eng): Can we commit to a perf matrix? Sales needs numbers.

Ethan (Head of Product): Yes — product + infra will produce a 1-pager. ETA: 2 weeks.

Cal (GTM): Competitor angle: clouds have managed endpoints now. How do we differentiate in one sentence?

Nora (CEO): We offer predictable unit economics and a single control plane across deployment modes; clouds give endpoints, we give production-ready inference with operational levers.

Rae (PM): action items: product -> perf sheet, migration checklist; eng -> infra blockers list; GTM -> customer POC template. I'll centralize on the board.

intel-bot: Reminder set for #product in 48h to post perf sheet draft.

Nora (CEO): Thanks — appreciate the quick alignment. We'll follow up at the next all-hands.

Ethan (Head of Product): linking the board: https://rwd.internal/boards/INF-ALIGN-1786 (internal)
